programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep06

programme.title: PandoraHearts Ep07

programme.title: PandoraHearts Ep08
programme.desc: Oz wakes up in Gilbert's home at Reveille, where Break quells many of his doubts, but some about the Abyss are left unanswered. Later, Oz suddenly feels an excruciating pain in his chest.

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep07
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep08
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? III Ep12
programme.desc: The Xenos falls into the trap of Hermes who wants them dead. Upon learning Hermes' will, a group of Xenos begin rampaging on the surface.Orario falls into chaos as the monsters go berserk.

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? III Ep13
programme.desc: A 'natural' hot spring facility suddenly appears in Orario and becomes the talk of the town. Like everyone else, the Hestia Familia visits, but...

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? IV Ep01
programme.desc: Having protected Xenos and survived the fight against Asterius, Hestia Familia's Bell Cranel ranks up. Bell and the others are given an assignment to venture into the unexplored levels within the dungeon.

programme.title: Is it Wrong to Try to Pick up Girls in a Dungeon? IV Ep02
programme.desc: Bell and the Hestia Familia join forces with Miach, Takemikazuchi, and Aisha to explore deeper dungeon floors. Strengthened by resolve, Bell prepares for the unknown challenges ahead.

programme.title: The Vampire Dies in No Time Ep05
programme.desc: The Vampire Crimes Unit seeks help from Ronald and the others to track the immortal vampire, Street Slasher Nagiri. Draluc and John find a doll containing the Street Slasher's soul.

programme.title: The Vampire Dies in No Time Ep06
programme.desc: Upon Draluc's invitation, Ronald attends the Draluc clan's New Year's party. Ronald does his best to hide his identity while keeping an eye on the vampires.

programme.title: Bungo Stray Dogs S5 Ep02
programme.desc: The Armed Detective Agency is now free, and Ranpo succeeds in convincing the police to take action. Meanwhile, at the UN, Ochi Fukuchi delivers his speech to establish the 'Army of Mankind'.

programme.title: Bungo Stray Dogs S5 Ep03
programme.desc: While Atsushi stands before Kamui, Akutagawa arrives. Atsushi and Akutagawa devise a surprise attack, but... Fukuchi reaches into hyperspace and unsheaths 'Ame no Gozen', the divine blade.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the exam. When an accident changes everything tragically, Zhang travels back in time. Can he amend things this time?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert

programme.title: Out of Order

programme.title: Love for All Seasons

programme.title: One and Only

programme.title: Last Suspect

programme.title: Mama's Affair
